scope: Local runtime implementation and regression proof for per-device visibility through the Editor Inspector, Layers panel, Canvas, draft Save, and explicit Publish.

implementation.behavior: Each non-root layer has a keyboard-accessible visibility button that shows its pressed state and targets the Canvas active device (desktop/tablet/mobile). It invokes the existing element.visibility.set command and Page Model property; Inspector and Layers do not maintain duplicate state. Locked nodes disable the control. Save remains draft-only and Publish is explicit.

assertions: All 44 PARTIAL types expose per-device Inspector visibility commands and Page Model keys.
Canvas own/ancestor hidden state and Undo/Redo are synchronized.
Save persists hidden draft state without changing public output; explicit Publish changes mobile public output.
Showing nodes again remains draft-only until Save and Publish; desktop output remains independent.
Structural authored content retains renderer semantics through undo/redo and publication.
Hidden or hidden-parent schedules do not fetch on mobile while visible wider breakpoints still fetch.
